coverage/unit --timeout 15000 --isolate --max-concurrency=1 ./packages/mcp && cp coverage/unit/lcov.info coverage/unit/lcov.mcp.info && bun test --coverage --coverage-reporter text --coverage-reporter lcov --coverage-dir coverage/unit --timeout 15000 --isolate --max-concurrency=1 ./packages/opencode && cp coverage/unit/lcov.info coverage/unit/lcov.opencode.info && bun test --coverage
